contradictions.summary: Official City, QTS, and Alliant sources confirm investment, acreage, buildings/phases, and addresses but do not publish campus IT/load capacity. Third-party trackers report conflicting or unattributed figures, so capacity_mw remains null.

The executed City development agreement and 2025 City announcement cite a $750 million minimum investment; QTS and Alliant now describe a planned $10 billion campus. Treated as minimum committed vs planned buildout, not a direct conflict.

construction_deadlines.next_phase_commence: within 3 years of initial phase completion

cooling.notes: City, QTS, and Alliant describe water-free or closed-loop cooling; QTS states the Cedar Rapids campus does not consume water for cooling.
